map.由物镜与目镜焦距，按 M = f₀/fₑ 计算望远镜角放大率。: From the objective and eyepiece focal lengths, compute the telescope angular magnification using M = f₀/fₑ.
map.📖 查看「折射望远镜角放大率 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Refracting Telescope Angular Magnification User Guide"
map.开普勒望远镜用两凸透镜，放大率为正表示倒像。: A Keplerian telescope uses two convex lenses; a positive magnification indicates an inverted image.
map.放大率越大视场越小，受衍射极限约束。: The larger the magnification the smaller the field of view, limited by the diffraction limit.
map.由物镜/目镜焦距比算角放大。: From the objective/eyepiece focal length ratio, compute the angular magnification.
map.选倍率配口径与稳定。: Choose the magnification to match the aperture and stability.
map.手抖/亮度权衡。: Trade-off between hand shake and brightness.
map.物镜焦距 1000mm、目镜 25mm → 放大 M=1000/25=40×；换: Objective focal length 1000mm, eyepiece 25mm → magnification M=1000/25=40×; switch to a 10mm eyepiece → 100×.
map.倍率×2 出瞳直径减半、亮度降 1/4，手持 >10× 易抖需脚架；天文大倍配大: Doubling the magnification halves the exit pupil diameter and reduces brightness to 1/4; handheld >10× is prone to shake and needs a tripod; for astronomy, pair high magnification with a large aperture to keep it bright.
map.否。倍率超「口径(mm)/倍数≈7」手持抖、亮变暗、像质降，需脚架与足够口径。: No. Beyond the rule of thumb "aperture (mm)/magnification ≈ 7", handheld views shake, dim and lose quality, needing a tripod and sufficient aperture.
map.受口径（亮度/分辨）、大气视宁度与手持稳定，地面观测约 2×口径(mm) 为实用: Limited by aperture (brightness/resolution), atmospheric seeing and handheld stability; for ground observation the practical upper limit is about 2× aperture (mm).
